module_summary: RISC-V integer execute unit: decodes opcode into ALU function/operands for a child ALU with a flopped result, and resolves branches into registered branch requests plus a same-cycle early branch request.

anchors.name: opcode_valid_i
anchors.why: Issued-instruction valid; enables branch result registers and early branch request.

anchors.name: opcode_opcode_i
anchors.why: Instruction word decoded to choose ALU op, operands and branch type.

anchors.name: opcode_ra_operand_i
anchors.why: Source operand A feeding ALU inputs and branch comparisons.

anchors.name: opcode_rb_operand_i
anchors.why: Source operand B feeding ALU input B and branch comparisons.

anchors.name: opcode_pc_i
anchors.why: Instruction PC used for auipc/jal operands and branch target computation.

anchors.name: hold_i
anchors.why: Pipeline stall; blocks update of the flopped ALU result.

anchors.name: imm12_r
anchors.why: Sign-extended I-type immediate for ALU operand B and jalr target.

anchors.name: alu_func_r
anchors.why: Decoded ALU operation code driving the ALU child.

anchors.name: alu_input_a_r
anchors.why: Selected ALU operand A: register, PC or upper immediate.

anchors.name: alu_input_b_r
anchors.why: Selected ALU operand B: register, immediate, shamt or 4.

anchors.name: alu_p_w
anchors.why: ALU result from child, registered into the writeback result.

anchors.name: writeback_value_o
anchors.why: Writeback value output, copy of flopped ALU result.

anchors.name: branch_r
anchors.why: Decoded is-branch/jump flag qualifying all branch outputs.

anchors.name: branch_taken_r
anchors.why: Branch condition result from operand comparisons; selects next PC.

anchors.name: branch_target_r
anchors.why: Computed branch/jump target address (PC+imm or rs1+imm).

anchors.name: branch_call_r
anchors.why: Classifies jump as call (rd=RA); with ret/jmp flags for predictor.

anchors.name: branch_request_o
anchors.why: Registered branch-resolved request (taken or not taken) to frontend.

anchors.name: branch_pc_o
anchors.why: Registered next-PC (target or PC+4) for the branch request.

anchors.name: branch_is_taken_o
anchors.why: Registered taken indication accompanying branch request.

anchors.name: branch_source_o
anchors.why: Registered PC of the resolved branch instruction.

anchors.name: branch_d_request_o
anchors.why: Same-cycle early taken-branch request using combinational target.

anchors.name: branch_d_pc_o
anchors.why: Early branch target address output.

groups.name: Immediate decode
groups.description: Extracts U/I/B/J immediates and shift amount from the opcode.

groups.name: ALU operation decode
groups.description: Opcode mask compare selects ALU function and operand A/B sources.

groups.name: ALU and result register
groups.description: Child ALU computes result, flopped into result_q unless held.

groups.name: Branch resolution
groups.description: Evaluates branch conditions, target and call/ret/jmp class.

groups.name: Branch output registers
groups.description: Registers branch outcome, next PC and type on valid; early request bypass.
